messages:
Claire (PM): Quick thread to lock down the Dedicated PRD items around drift and the degradation playbook. Need concise acceptance criteria we can ship to Sales for contracts.
Diego (SRE): Proposal: add a Drift SLA clause — if observed capacity drift >7% for 10m vs committed baseline, trigger a remediation workflow and customer notification.
Ellen (Sales): Customers want credits for SLA breaches. We need a clear formula: credit = min(1% monthly fee per 0.1% availability shortfall, cap 50%). Legal will scrub.
Marcus (Infra): Operational note: "drift" definition must exclude scheduled maintenance windows and planned capacity changes. Also exclude region-level cloud incidents.
Claire (PM): Good point. Acceptance criteria draft: 1) SLOs and breach definitions in PRD; 2) automated detection for drift with runbook links; 3) chaos-tested degrade path validated in perf lab.
Diego (SRE): Autoscale targets: warm scale (nodes with warmed model cache) add 1.8x throughput in <= 180s; cold scale (new node + model load) target 10m. We'll provide histograms.
Marcus (Infra): Add a soft-queue behaviour: when pool at 100% we can either queue up to Q (config per contract) or fail-fast. Default: fail-fast for low-latency products, queue for batch customers.
Ellen (Sales): Make queue vs fail-fast configurable at contract level. Also require an explicit opt-in for cross-routing to hosted fallback.
QA Bot: Checklist reminder: include chaos tests for node preemption, KV cache eviction, and firewall/network offtimes. Each test must have pass criteria (p95 regression <30% vs baseline).
Claire (PM): Add observability acceptance: must have per-route p95, retry counts, queue-depth, and autoscale-lag dashboards ready. Queries and dashboard links included in PRD.
Diego (SRE): Rollback playbook: partial rollback to a smaller model in the same pool if sustained p95 > 2x baseline for 5m, escalate to full rollback after 15m. Manual abort button present in console.
Marcus (Infra): Cost KPI: report cost per 1M tokens for committed pool vs hosted fallback. Report must be surfaced to customer monthly.
Ellen (Sales): Include a line for beta customers: reduced credits during private preview but must sign off on acceptance tests.
Claire (PM): Edge cases to call out: noisy-tenant burst from single tenant, KV cache thrash from long-context jobs, and mixed workload (embeddings + gen) contention. Spell mitigation strategies.
Diego (SRE): On-call: define a 2-step alerting policy: 1) SRE paging on sustained p99 > 1s for 5m, 2) escalation to Eng after 15m if unresolved. Add playbook references.
Jenkins: Deploy note: canary rollout must validate p95 and queue-depth metrics for 30m before wider rollout.
Claire (PM): Final acceptance-run phases: lab perf -> contract-specific canary -> customer acceptance run -> GA. Go/no-go checklist required for each phase.
Ellen (Sales): I'll send a skeleton contract clause for credits and fallback opt-ins to Claire by EOD.
Diego (SRE): Action items: I'll create the drift-detection alert, Marcus will build the soft-queue config, QA Bot will run the chaos matrix.
Claire (PM): Thanks all. I'll update the PRD and tag reviewers. Aim to lock this by next Mon.
